entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It took a while,[n]but I got some info.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: First, I heard something from[n]Mr. Manda, my math teacher.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Apparently he knows what[n]Ms. Kawakami's doing!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Kinda makes you respect[n]Ms. Kawakami a bit, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Next up! I heard this from[n]a second-year girl.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: She was pretty cute.[n]She likes European sweets.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So apparently Ms. Kawakami[n]used to work part-time at[n]a bakery called Becky.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Can you believe she did a part-time[n]job? She's such a hard worker![n]And finally, number three!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: By the entrance to the school,[n]a first-year girl was handing out[n]flyers for the drama club!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It looks like they're going to do a[n]play about maids. The girl handing[n]out the flyers was super cute.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So, what do you think?[n]Was that helpful?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Let me know if anything[n]else comes up.
